verdict.rationale: Time tracking is a fair question for a work-tracking tool, but the evidence pack never documents native time logging (worklogs) against Jira issues or projects. The only time-related mention is Tempo Timesheets, a third-party Marketplace app. That is an add-on rather than Jira's own capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can log time directly against tasks and projects
